notes: Source: UqzQGpGU0FI, spell_policy and uncertain: eight Totems total; their brewed/donated split is not spoken. game data v18.200.9: Totem.HousingSpace=1, Rage.HousingSpace=2, Revive.HousingSpace=2 -> five brewed Totems, two Rages and one Revive use 11 housing; the other three Totems are donated. This split is inferred from capacity, preserving the cited spell totals.

All nine complete source compositions are different, so there is no most common complete composition. The army uses UqzQGpGU0FI as a representative of the Dragon Duke funnel and grouped Meteor Golem plan. Its hero equipment matches -jNbwwWqnOE. This is a tie-break, not a claim that eight Meteor Golems are the most common count. Four Meteor Golems occur in three sources; five Healers occur in six.

Support counts describe the shared tactical action, not unanimous agreement on troop quantity, exact ordering, loadout or trigger. In particular, the seven sources supporting a main Meteor Golem deployment do not all describe the two-Golem funnel. The explicit Apprentice Warden, King, Queen, Warden and Troop Launcher order comes from -jNbwwWqnOE and UqzQGpGU0FI.

t=0 means the stated start of the attack. Citation times are video timestamps, not attack-clock delays. No source supplies a fixed wait for funnel completion. All zero-delay dependencies preserve narrated order without inventing a duration; they do not establish that the funnel has actually finished.

group_inside:main approximates reaching the core and the main army approaching the fallen Dragon Duke. It cannot establish the actual core location, proximity to his fallen position, destruction of an Air Defense or a distracted Monolith. The heavy_fire and defenders_near alternatives approximate the narrated Warden ability conditions without inventing health thresholds.

Totem support is described as repeated, discretionary placement, but no source supplies a casting interval. Consequently no every value is invented. totem_main encodes one supported cast; the remaining Totems have no executable schedule in this object. Additional Dragon Duke revivals in compositions carrying multiple Revive Spells likewise have no invented repeat interval.

The revival anchor unit:Dragon Duke resolves his actual corpse in current Rust, as confirmed by the Meteor Golem review. Source-specific safe-revival conditions remain approximate; hero lifecycle handling is separate from anchor resolution. Surplus spells can use fallback.

The Warden-walk and Fireball variants are supported partial substitutions, not complete executable conversions between the source armies. Their inventories, hero rosters and loadouts differ from the default army. The schema provides no variant army field. The two variants with empty steps document distinct plans whose complete deployment sequence cannot be reconstructed without supplying unspoken placements or prerequisites.

The Warden-walk variant uses MUssbWM-qpk's two test Balloons; yBFCuLpbDbU uses one. MUssbWM-qpk deploys the Dragon Duke on the opposite corner and uses Ruin Witches. yBFCuLpbDbU instead uses three Furnaces, a funneling Queen and a King/Royal Champion flank. Their later hero and spell sequences must not be treated as interchangeable.

Fireball sources specify Invisibility setup but do not identify the spell circles. lHLHvW8vFTg budgets four Invisibility Spells; lTp7FjulP8Q and y7npC3rCP3g describe two in particular openings. lHLHvW8vFTg follows Fireball with Earthquakes, but their placement is unspecified. These casts are not assigned invented anchors. The zero-delay Fireball dependency does not reproduce the omitted targeting setup. Ruin Witches belong to lHLHvW8vFTg's composition, not every Fireball composition.

The immediate Queen ability applies to Healer Puppet and Action Figure in -jNbwwWqnOE, UqzQGpGU0FI and yBFCuLpbDbU. MUssbWM-qpk combines Magic Mirror with Rage, Rocket Spear and Eternal Tome. lTp7FjulP8Q and y7npC3rCP3g use later Queen abilities. uRJw__PO-Iw explicitly advises against immediate hero abilities and supplies no precise replacement trigger.

The opposite-side Queen anchor is an approximation because uRJw__PO-Iw does not tie that side to a named edge. Likewise, edge anchors preserve narrated flank relationships without inventing compass directions or deployment coordinates. The Super Archer variant's final deployment follows the other deployments, but the vocabulary has no direct trigger for defenses first acquiring the leading troops.

Alternative composition -jNbwwWqnOE: 6 Meteor Golems, 7 Super Archers, 1 Apprentice Warden and 4 Wall Breakers; 6 Totem, 2 Revive and 1 Poison Spells. Troop Launcher is named, but its troop payload and donated spell split are unresolved. Four main Meteor Golems and five main Super Archers are the source extraction's remainders after the two-of-each funnel allocation.

Alternative composition MUssbWM-qpk: 4 Meteor Golems, 4 Ruin Witches, 2 Balloons, 5 Healers and 1 Super Wall Breaker; 1 Rage, 3 Revive, 1 Freeze and 2 Invisibility Spells; Clan Castle Log Launcher, 1 Poison and 3 Totem Spells, with two troop identities unresolved. Heroes are Grand Warden, Dragon Duke, Archer Queen and Royal Champion; the Warden has Eternal Tome, the Queen Magic Mirror, and the Duke Fire Heart/Revenge Deck. Exact remaining Ruin Witch and main-army deployment details are incomplete.

Alternative composition lHLHvW8vFTg: 5 Healers, 3 Balloons, 4 Meteor Golems, 2 Ruin Witches, 1 Apprentice Warden, 3 Super Barbarians, 3 Headhunters and 2 Archers; 4 Invisibility, 5 Earthquake, 1 Totem and 1 Freeze Spells. Clan Castle contains 1 Archer, 3 Rocket Balloons, 2 Ice Golems, Troop Launcher, 1 Overgrowth and 1 Revive Spell. Heroes are Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden and Dragon Duke, with Fireball on the Warden. The 'arrow backpack' activation sequence and the identities called 'cake' and 'logger' remain unresolved.

Alternative composition lTp7FjulP8Q: 5 Healers, 3 Meteor Golems, 3 Throwers, 1 Apprentice Warden, 3 Ice Golems, 4 Archers, 3 Balloons, 2 Super Wall Breakers, 2 Wizards and 1 Headhunter; 4 Invisibility, 1 Earthquake, 1 Overgrowth, 1 Rage and 2 Totem Spells. Heroes are Archer Queen, Grand Warden, Royal Champion and Dragon Duke, with Fireball on the Warden. Meteor Golem, Ice Golem and Apprentice Warden deployments are not verbally specified.

Clan Castle lists 2 Balloons, 1 Minion, 1 Rocket Balloon, 1 Ice Golem, 1 Root Rider, 1 Poison, 2 Lightning and 1 Freeze Spell. Siege choices include Log Launcher, Flame Flinger and Troop Launcher; Troop Launcher is identified in the first attack. Heroes are Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden and Dragon Duke, with Fireball on the Warden. Meteor Golem, Healer and Thrower deployment order is not narrated.

Alternative composition yBFCuLpbDbU: 5 Healers, 3 Furnaces, 5 Meteor Golems, 3 Balloons and 1 Archer; 8 Totem, 1 Rage and 1 Invisibility Spell. Clan Castle lists 1 Balloon, 1 Super Yeti, 1 Ice Golem, 1 Poison, 1 Invisibility and 1 Revive Spell. Siege choices are Troop Launcher, Log Launcher and Siege Barracks, with Troop Launcher deployment narrated. Heroes are Barbarian King, Archer Queen, Grand Warden and Royal Champion. The Warden has Rage Gem/Life Gem, so no Eternal Tome activation belongs to that composition. Royal Champion is the usual Revive target, with an early fallen Warden as an exception.

Army-changing variants require the corresponding source inventory and loadouts. Available siege options in army links do not establish multiple siege deployments. Unnamed troop IDs, unspecified cleanup actions, undefined equipment combinations and garbled targets have not been converted into additional steps.
